ns2:course.label: Aerospace Dynamical Systems
ns2:course.description: Particle kinematics and dynamics; Lagrange's equations; vibration of multiple degree-of-freedom systems; rotational kinematics and dynamics of rigid bodies. Credit is not given toward graduation for both AE 352 and TAM 412. Prerequisite: MATH 225, MATH 257, or MATH 415; MATH 285, MATH 284, MATH 286, or MATH 441; and TAM 212.
